tenantAdmin.title: Tenants
tenantAdmin.description: Workspaces isolated within this instance. Each tenant has its own content; the reserved "shio" tenant is the single-tenant default.
tenantAdmin.blankDescription: Create a tenant to host an isolated workspace. New tenants are seeded with a copy of the default content model.
tenantAdmin.generalDesc: The tenant identifier and its details.
tenantAdmin.name: Name
tenantAdmin.nameHint: The tenant identifier carried on its content. Lowercase, no spaces. Immutable once created.
tenantAdmin.nameImmutable: The tenant name cannot be changed after creation.
tenantAdmin.defaultHint: The reserved default tenant cannot be renamed, disabled or deleted.
tenantAdmin.provisionHint: Copy the default tenant's post-type model into this tenant. Idempotent.
tenantAdmin.planHint: Billing plan that drives create limits. FREE is bounded; any other value is unlimited.
tenantSwitcher.label: Switch tenant
tenantLink.copied: Link copied. It names {{tenant}}, and opening it will not switch anyone.
tenantLink.body: This link was written for {{claimed}}. You are working in {{current}}, and nothing has changed.
tenantLink.notMember: You are not a member of {{tenant}}, so this link cannot be opened the way it was meant.
